anchor_state_rationale: Sprint-9 Tag-2 sandbox boundary: Bitcoin-anchor submission is operator-hand. The schema digest is pinned (schema_file_sha256 above) and the OTS-anchor-pipeline manifest is materialised; the operator-side submission step (wat.anchor.ots_anchor.anchor_root) materialises schema.sha256.bin.ots and flips anchor_state to PENDING.
verifier_contract: 2. Verifier computes sha256(schema-file-bytes) and compares to schema_file_sha256 (this manifest).
3. Verifier loads tests/fixtures/schema-registry/caveat-override-event-export-v1/schema.sha256.bin and compares its bytes byte-for-byte against the recomputed digest.
4. When anchor_state >= PENDING, verifier verifies schema.sha256.bin.ots attests to the contents of schema.sha256.bin (wat.anchor.ots_anchor.verify_receipt contract).
5. When anchor_state == FINALISED, verifier additionally cross-validates the BitcoinBlockHeaderAttestation(H) heights via wat.anchor.esplora.confirm_block_at_height.
anchor_state_machine: PENDING (operator submitted to OTS calendars; .ots receipt persisted)
FINALISED (Bitcoin block confirmation observed; receipt upgraded)
